logo.title: Logos
logo.subtitle: Approved lockups and the rules that keep them recognizable.
logo.loadError: We couldn't load the logo files. Please try again.
logo.clearspaceDescription: Keep clearspace of at least 50% of the logomark height on every side. Nothing — text, imagery, or edges — enters that space.
logo.minimumSize: Minimum size: never render the wordmark or the full lockup below 150px wide, or the logomark below 40px.

dos.clearspace: Keep the full clearspace around the lockup.
dos.approvedFiles: Use the vector files from this page — always the latest version.
dos.contrast: Place the logo on surfaces with enough contrast to stay legible.

donts.stretch: Don't stretch or squash the logo.
donts.containers: Don't place the logo inside containers or holding shapes.
donts.shear: Don't shear or skew the logo.

logo.allFilesDescription: Every K Lab and product logo in the catalog, including vector masters for print.
logo.primaryDescription: The two core treatments from the brand guidelines. Match the lockup to its surface — never swap them.

whiteOnBlack.label: White on black
whiteOnBlack.description: The reversed white lockup on black and other dark surfaces.

greyOnWhite.label: Grey on white
greyOnWhite.description: The charcoal grey lockup on white and other light surfaces.

logo.cobrandingDescription: Partner lockups pair the K Lab logo with the partner logo on either side of a thin vertical divider.

cobranding.divider: Separate the two logos with a thin vertical divider the height of the K Lab logomark.
cobranding.spacing: Keep a gap of 50% of the logomark width between each logo and the divider.
cobranding.parity: Scale the partner logo so both wordmarks read at the same height.

colors.title: Colors
colors.subtitle: The official K Lab palette from the brand guidelines.
colors.copyFailed: We couldn't copy that. Try selecting the value instead.

primaryPalette.title: Primary palette
primaryPalette.description: Our palette is the most emotive part of our identity. Usage must remain consistent to build strong brand recognition.

secondaryColors.title: Secondary colors
secondaryColors.description: Our palette is the most emotive part of our identity. Usage must remain consistent to build strong brand recognition.

neutrals.title: Neutral colors
neutrals.description: Neutrals provide the necessary negative space for our primary colors to shine. They are the backbone of our UI and layout.

gradients.title: Gradients
gradients.description: Gradients add depth and dimension to our visual language. They should be used to highlight key interactions or as immersive backgrounds, never for body text.

statusColors.title: Status colors
statusColors.description: Data-viz state colors for product dashboards — approved, pending, disputed, critical, informational, and archived states. Kept separate from the brand palette: they signal state, never brand.

typography.title: Typography
typography.subtitle: The official K Lab typeface from the brand guidelines.
typography.typefaceDescription: Our brand typeface is clean, modern, and highly legible. Its letterforms reflect our brand's personality: confident, clear, and approachable. This versatile font family is used across all brand communications to create a consistent and unified typographic voice.
typography.hierarchyDescription: Our type hierarchy uses distinct weights and sizes to create clear and scannable content. Follow this structure for headers, sub-headers, and body text to ensure legibility and consistency.

imagery.title: Imagery
imagery.subtitle: Approved backgrounds and textures, and how to apply them.

dos.approvedSets: Use the approved sets below for decks, covers, and hero sections.
dos.contrast: Keep text over imagery legible — add an overlay if contrast drops.
dos.crop: Crop to the focal area rather than scaling the whole image down.

donts.stretch: Don't stretch images to fit a frame.
donts.recolor: Don't recolor or heavily filter brand imagery.
donts.clutter: Don't stack multiple busy images in one layout.

iconography.title: Iconography
iconography.subtitle: The icon language that keeps product UI consistent with the brand.
iconography.styleDescription: A set built for the payment lifecycle. Icons follow the geometry of the K mark: rounded geometric strokes, one consistent weight, no decoration. Lucide glyphs stand in below until the bespoke K Lab set ships.

dos.set: Use icons from the approved set at their native stroke weight.
dos.stroke: Keep one stroke style per screen — never mix filled and outlined icons.
dos.color: Color icons with the text color of their context.

donts.mix: Don't mix icon families in one interface.
donts.fill: Don't fill outlined icons or redraw their shapes.
donts.effects: Don't add shadows, gradients, or outlines to icons.
donts.logo: Don't use the K Lab logomark as an interface icon.

iconography.libraryDescription: Published icon files, with every available format.

corporateAssets.title: Corporate assets
corporateAssets.subtitle: Stationery and document templates that carry the brand into daily business.
corporateAssets.systemDescription: The layouts below mirror the brand guidelines. Print-ready templates are being prepared by the design team — use these references to review layouts until they ship.

letterhead.title: Letterhead
letterhead.description: White sheet with the charcoal lockup top-left, blueprint linework across the header, and generous white body space.

cover.title: Document cover
cover.description: Dark navy cover with the key visual artwork and the white lockup bottom-left.

businessCard.title: Business card
businessCard.description: A clean layout with core brand elements — dark face with the white lockup, light face with the charcoal lockup.

rules.templates: Start from the approved templates — don't rebuild documents from scratch.
rules.clearspace: Respect logo clearspace and minimum sizes on every document.
rules.typography: Set documents in Sora for headings and Arial for body text.

corporateAssets.libraryDescription: Published stationery templates, ready to use.

photography.title: Photography
photography.subtitle: The photographic mood of the brand and the approved visuals to use today.
photography.principlesDescription: The photography library is in production. Until it ships, follow these principles from the brand guidelines and use the approved renders below.

mood.title: Dark, technical mood
mood.description: Deep navy scenes with cool blue accents — confident, precise, engineered.

light.title: Neon light
light.description: Cyan edge-light and glow reserved for the brandmark and key surfaces.

space.title: Copy space
space.description: Compositions keep calm negative space for headlines and lockups.

people.title: Real work
people.description: People appear in context — hands, screens, and real product moments, never staged stock poses.

dos.palette: Grade imagery toward the brand palette — navy, cyan, neutral greys.
dos.overlay: Add a dark overlay when text sits on imagery.
dos.focal: Crop to a clear focal point and keep backgrounds calm.

donts.filters: Don't apply warm filters or heavy effects.
donts.busy: Don't stack busy imagery behind text or logos.

photography.rendersDescription: Product renders cleared for marketing and deck use — download at full resolution.

socialMedia.title: Social media
socialMedia.subtitle: Avatar and banner treatments for K Lab's social channels.
socialMedia.avatarsDescription: Three approved treatments from the guidelines: the logomark on the blue gradient or graphite field, and the wordmark on dark textured surfaces. Keep the mark centered and generously sized.
socialMedia.bannersDescription: Banners pair a brand background with the white lockup and at most one short headline. Keep the safe area clear — platforms crop aggressively.

bannerRules.lockup: Use the white lockup on dark or gradient backgrounds.
bannerRules.copySpace: One headline maximum — let the background breathe.
bannerRules.contrast: Check contrast after platform cropping and overlays.

socialMedia.libraryDescription: Published avatar and banner exports for each channel.

merchandise.title: Merchandise
merchandise.subtitle: How the brand shows up on the things we wear, use, and give away.
merchandise.itemsDescription: The guideline range covers apparel, drinkware, and stationery. Product photography is on the way — the treatments below match the guideline artboards.

tshirt.title: T-shirt
tshirt.description: Black tee with the white lockup badge and the faceted blue K artwork with contour linework.

cap.title: Cap
cap.description: Navy cap with the white embroidered lockup badge on the front.

drinkware.title: Drinkware
drinkware.description: Matte navy tumblers and mugs with the white lockup and fine technical linework.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.description: Hardcover notebook wrapped in the neon K key visual with the white lockup bottom-left.

tote.title: Tote Bag
tote.description: Navy tote with the white lockup and fine technical linework.

rules.surface: Produce merchandise on navy or black surfaces — never bright or patterned stock.
rules.lockup: Use the white lockup and keep embroidery and prints at legible sizes.
rules.linework: Technical blueprint linework is the only approved decorative element.
rules.approval: New merchandise concepts need brand-team approval before production.

merchandise.libraryDescription: Published merchandise artwork and production files.

subBrands.title: Sub-brands
subBrands.subtitle: The product family and the lockup system that binds it to K Lab.
subBrands.systemDescription: Every sub-brand pairs the chevron mark — drawn from the arrow of the K — with its name in the brand typeface. Lockups are monochrome: charcoal on light surfaces, white on dark. No sub-brand carries its own color.
subBrands.rosterDescription: The four approved sub-brands. Retired marks (Kena) must not appear in new work.
